lines: Do you know what you’re saying?

shots.label: Open rafiq-arabic.com on your phone. Hold on the home page, then scroll slowly.
Your salah → Most-said words 1–5 → Word by word. Pause on a word: its meaning and root are on the card. Tap it to hear it.
Keep scrolling the word cards, slowly. The captions sit over the lower part.

captions.text: Every word of your salah — explained.
Free for a week. No card needed.

lines: I built an app so you can understand your own prayer.

shots.label: A calm glimpse of the app: the home screen, scrolling very slowly. No taps.
Your salah: the parts of the prayer in order (the map). Scroll slowly.
Back to the home screen: the Continue button, held still.

captions.text: We memorise the words. Most of us never learn what they mean.
Short daily lessons from the very first letter, and what every word of your prayer means.
Made for the ummah. Free for a week, no card needed.

shots.label: Your salah → Al-Fātihah (1) → Word by word. Scroll slowly down the four lines.
Pause on two or three words: the meaning and root are on each card. Keep the phone on silent.
Hold, or keep scrolling, under the caption.

captions.text: Then do the same for your whole salah.

outro.note: Free for a week · no card needed
